name: MQ ~Jikuu no Hasha~
source:
Shou, who faced his mother's tragic death, was given a word, "Collect fills...." As a matter of fact, she wasn't his own mother. He, who was surprised to hear the fact, got to know his varied fate soon. One day, a girl appears in front of him, "The world is being destroyed, Avatar." "Destroyed? Do you mean we are going extinct?" "The council has decided to erase you...." "Me? Killed? How come?" "Because you are the one who will lead this world to ruin. I objected to the decision and left the council. Collect fills as soon as possible...." The girl, who came to this world to protect him, promises him to care for him as a valet. She also tells him that she is a daughter of the former valet. "A daughter of the former valet?" "Yes, the girl who used to live as your mother. I'm her daughter." "...!?" The girl tells him to get out of this world soon. Like this, their adventure starts....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
翔目睹母亲悲惨离世后，得到一句话：“收集Fill…”事实上，她并不是翔的亲生母亲。震惊于这个事实的翔，很快便了解到自己变化莫测的命运。一天，一名少女出现在他面前。
“世界正在毁灭，Avatar。”
“毁灭？你是说我们会灭绝吗？”
“议会已经决定抹除你…”
“我？要杀我？为什么？”
“因为你将引领这个世界走向毁灭。我反对这项决定，已经离开议会。请尽快收集Fill…”
为了保护翔而来到这个世界的少女承诺，会作为侍从照顾他。她还告诉翔，自己是上一任侍从的女儿。
“上一任侍从的女儿？”
“是的，就是曾以你母亲身份生活的那名女子。我是她的女儿。”
“…！？”
少女催促翔尽快离开这个世界。就这样，两人的冒险开始了…

[摘自ErogeShop]
